description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs verify_chain loops over chain[i] and calls check_revocation only when chain[i+1] exists. The last cert in chain — the one whose issuer is the trust anchor — is never checked. For a typical [leaf, intermediate_CA] chain, only leaf is checked; intermediate_CA's revocation status is never queried. A revoked intermediate CA can continue to sign new leaf certs that pass full chain validation. The limitation is documented in the function docstring but has no compile-time or runtime signal — callers who skim the API will miss it. Fix options: (a) extend the RevocationChecker trait to accept TrustAnchor as issuer for the last cert, (b) require the trust anchor cert to appear in chain so it appears as chain[n-1]'s issuer, (c) add a dedicated check_revocation_against_anchor method. The right fix changes the API; file separately before touching code.
title: verify_chain never revocation-checks the cert issued by the trust anchor
